title: Shared ring-site Hom extension definitions
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism. Write $\mathcal M_A$ for sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A$ on the one-object category with only its identity arrow and bottom topology [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and similarly for $B$. RingSiteModules denotes $\mathcal M_A$, and ringSiteMap denotes the constant ring-sheaf map induced by $\varphi$. For cochain complexes $P,Q$ in $\mathcal M_A$, ringHomComplexProjection denotes the projections $H_A(P,Q)^n\to\mathcal Hom_A(P^p,Q^{p+n})$ from the exact limiting fan selected together with the shared Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex, def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For a site object $U$, ringHomEvaluate evaluates this projection at the identity object of the slice over $U$. Given an additive functor $F:\mathcal M_A\to\mathcal M_B$, ringExtensionComplex applies $F$ termwise to cochain complexes. Given equalities $h_M:F(M)=\operatorname{changeOfRings}_{\varphi}(M)$, ringExtensionPure sends $b\in B$ and $x\in M(U)$ to the image of $b\otimes_A x$ under the scalar-extension presheaf sheafification unit followed by $h_M^{-1}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].
